lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Capitol Hill, 2064, after midnight. The floor vote was this afternoon and it carried. The signatures are tonight, because the vote is the part that gets reported and the signatures are the part that does anything.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Empty seats. A lectern with the order paper still on it. A clerk at a side table with a register, required to witness every hand that signs, and required to say nothing about any of them.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I have never been allowed on this floor. Four years, eleven amendments, and I have watched this room through the glass at the back because tabling requires a sponsor and I am staff.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I could tell you where every member sits. I have never heard what it sounds like in here.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The treaty passed this afternoon in front of cameras. Whatever is being signed at one in the morning with no press in the building is not the treaty.
